decision.summary: No documented official/public historical lineage was established that exhaustively and immutably reconstructs all Binance USD-M perpetual listing epochs, actual terminal states/times and identity changes before the cutoff. Current exchangeInfo is current-state only; !contractInfo is live-only; announcements are individual mutable pages without a documented complete machine ledger. A fail-closed offline resolver, tests and exact one-shot T1 metadata budget were frozen. No market body, outcome or X1-003 work occurred.
allowed_claims: Current exchangeInfo fields are useful only as a current control snapshot, not retrospective completeness proof.
The official contractInfo stream can support prospective capture but does not document historical replay.
A deterministic metadata-only resolver and fail-closed evidence contract are frozen for a future authorized lineage source.
The exact future metadata-only request cap is 1,155 and response-byte cap is 161,480,704; no such acquisition ran here.
The source gap requires Strategy Manager disposition before X1 market-body access.
forbidden_reuse: Treating current exchangeInfo as a historical point-in-time universe
Inferring listing or delisting from first/last price, kline, trade or archive month
Assuming announcement search/category pagination is exhaustive or immutable without proof
Silently splicing renames, redenominations, multiplier changes or relistings
Using present survivors, realized coverage, liquidity, returns or correlation to repair the universe
Running X1-003, opening market bodies, or computing returns/correlation/lag/PnL
Treating source-strategy attention as a negative market result
Shared-state or PR lifecycle mutation without separate authority
